long_biography.plain_text:
Oil-field work gave Tony Buckingham the technical beginning for his business career. He started as a North Sea diver, then moved into negotiating exploration concessions for established energy companies. In 1992 he founded Heritage Oil, assembling international exploration interests before becoming its chief executive and major shareholder. The company's discoveries and asset sales made oil and gas the mechanism behind his wealth.

A Qatari-backed investment group acquired control of Heritage in 2014. Buckingham retained a minority interest and advisory role under the transaction, while the company's £924 million valuation represented the business rather than his personal fortune. He later made a strategic investment in a listed mining company, and today serves as founder and chief executive of natural-gas developer Albion Energy.
